## Rocky Brands, Inc. to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 27, 2026


October 20, 2026 4:05pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_44435d5418a8c753d82a3527f5edbe34/rockybrands/news/2026-10-20_Rocky_Brands_Inc_to_Report_Third_Quarter_2026_321.pdf)


NELSONVILLE, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Rocky Brands, Inc. (NASDAQ: RCKY) today announced that the company will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market close on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. Management will host a conference call that afternoon (October 27, 2026) at 4:30 p.m. ET to discuss the financial results.


Investors and analysts interested in participating in the call are invited to dial (877) 704-4453 (domestic) or (201) 389-0920 (international). The conference call will also be available to interested parties through a live webcast at[www.rockybrands.com](http://www.rockybrands.com/) . Please visit the website and select the “Investor Relations” link at least 15 minutes prior to the start of the call to register and download any necessary software.


A telephone replay of the call will be available until November 10, 2026, by dialing (844) 512-2921 (domestic) or (412) 317-6671 (international) and entering the conference identification number: 13763314.


**About Rocky Brands, Inc.** Rocky Brands, Inc. is a leading designer, manufacturer and marketer of premium quality footwear and apparel marketed under a portfolio of well recognized brand names. Brands in the portfolio include Rocky®, Georgia Boot®, Durango®, Lehigh®, The Original Muck Boot Company®, XTRATUF® and Ranger®. More information can be found at[RockyBrands.com](http://rockybrands.com/) .
